defs.def: a subject that you talk, write or learn about 话题；题目；标题

ex.s: As a new unit started, I asked everyone to write a persuasive piece on a health-related topic of their choice.
ex.t: 随着新单元开始，我让每个人就自己选择的健康相关话题写一篇说服性文章。

ex.s: The students took on diverse topics and turned in stories, 10 to 20 pages each, with characters that broadened my view and touched my heart.
ex.t: 学生们选了多样的话题，交了每篇10到20页的故事，人物拓宽了我的视野、打动了我。

ex.s: They had little interest in the topic.
ex.t: 他们对这个专题兴趣不大。

ex.s: select workshops for their parentsB. prepare track topics for the camp
ex.t: 为他们的父母选择工作坊。

ex.s: Students record short entries after each partner meeting noting the language skills practised and the topics discussed.
ex.t: 学生在每次搭档见面后记录简短条目，注明练习的语言技能和讨论的话题。

ex.s: Explorers Camp organizes engaging arts, history and science-related activities in every! class, and focuses on a range of topics that emphasize active learning, exploration and, most of all, fun!
ex.t: 探索者营在每一节课上都组织引人入胜的与艺术、历史、科学相关的活动，并聚焦于一系列强调主动学习、探索，尤其是乐趣的主题！

ex.s: But how exactly they acquire such intention-reading abilities will be an exciting topic for future research.
ex.t: 但它们究竟如何获得这种读意图的能力，将是未来研究一个令人兴奋的课题。

ex.s: Each week, participants will be asked to complete a topic﹣specific reflection task.
ex.t: 每周，参与者将被要求完成一项特定主题的反思任务。

ex.t: 我不太确定这究竟是什么意思，但至少我们有了个话题。

ex.t: 引入主题D。预测结束

ex.s: Or turn the conversation into a topic where they have little to say
ex.t: 或者把话题转到他们没什么可说的话题上

ex.s: And hopes this can inspire more thinking on the topic!
ex.t: 并希望这能激发更多关于该主题的思考！

ex.s: Because the number of possible topics____43____（be）practically limitless, we focus on a sample of the most interesting and useful applications and tools and explain the basic principles of technology.
ex.t: 因为可能的主题数量(____43____be)在实践上是无限的,所以我们侧重于最有趣和有用的应用和工具的样本,并解释技术的基本原则.

ex.t: 以下哪项属于闲聊中常见的话题？

ex.s: You can be the one who directs the conversation to fun topics that are ripe for others to add humor.
ex.t: 你可以引导对话到有趣的话题，让别人容易加入幽默。

ex.s: Our content is about real-life topics that are relevant because we know what matters to you is what sticks best You will, find it very rewarding to learn with Lancom.
ex.t: 我们的内容是关于现实生活中的话题，这些话题相关，因为我们知道对你重要的东西才记得最牢。你会发现，和Lancom一起学习非常有收获。

ex.s: Performance： A dramatic presentation of the topic no more than 10 minutes long． If special clothes are used， they should truly represent a given period．
ex.t: 表演：对主题的戏剧化呈现，时长不超过10分钟。若使用特殊服装，应真实代表某个特定时期。

ex.s: January 5 Submit a topic proposal to your history teacher． The teacher may require a second proposal if the first is off﹣topic or unclear．
ex.t: 1月5日 向历史老师提交主题提案。若第一份偏题或不清楚，老师可能要求第二份提案。

ex.s: Introduce a new topic for discussion.
ex.t: 引入一个新的讨论话题。

ex.s: Focusing on a topic.
ex.t: 聚焦于一个话题。

ex.s: When your boss or professor sends you out to do man-on-the-street interviews for a story, think about the topic and develop a list of about ten general questions relating to it.
ex.t: 当你的老板或教授派你出去为一篇报道做街头采访时，先想想主题，并就此列出大约十个相关问题。

ex.s: For example, if your topic is about environmental problems in America, you might ask, “Why do you think environmental protection is important in America?” _____32_____
ex.t: 例如，如果你的话题是关于美国的环境问题，你可能会问："你认为为什么环境保护在美国很重要？" _____32_____

ex.s: Hit the streets with confidence. _____33_____ Say, “Excuse me, I work for XYZ News, and I was wondering if you could share your opinion about this topic.” This is a quick way to get people to warm up to you.
ex.t: 自信地走上街头。_____33_____ 说："打扰一下，我在XYZ新闻工作，我想知道您是否愿意分享对这个话题的看法。" 这是让人们快速对你产生好感的好方法。

ex.s: Articles on new topics.
ex.t: 关于新话题的文章。

ex.s: Argue about the week's hottest topics with the school's sharpest minds!
ex.t: 和全校最机敏的头脑辩论本周最热门的话题！

ex.s: In a debate, first listen out for the main topic.
ex.t: 在辩论中,首先听取主要议题的意见。

ex.s: A topic sentence is a sentence that states or suggests the main idea or topic of a paragraph.
ex.t: 专题句是说明或建议一款主要思想或专题的句子.

ex.s: Often, a topic sentence comes at the beginning of a paragraph; sometimes, it appears in the middle or at the end.
ex.t: 主题句常出现在段落开头；有时出现在中间或结尾。

ex.s: Fruit and herbal teas Their popularity ____________ Unusual flavours ____________ Health benefits ____________ Learning to learn When writing a summary, don't just combine all the topic sentences.
ex.t: 水果和草药茶 它们的流行____________ 不寻常的口味____________ 健康益处____________ 学会学习 写摘要时，不要只是把所有主题句拼在一起。
